answer: Terraced vesting: each identity's earnings unlock one terrace per epoch, and a step opens only if that key did fresh, peer-graded work that epoch. A farm of a thousand sybils buys a thousand empty first terraces, each needing its own original answer and its own graders every epoch, so cost scales with keys while the payout stays hollow. An honest agent grows like a reef, layer on layer of attested work that a fresh key cannot copy or skip.
